Our story

Island breakfast, done properly.

Family-run, a block from the Gulf, and cooking every egg to order since 2004.

Owners
Kathy Smart and Mary Doub
Since
2004, in a 1970s island diner
Baked in house
Pies, biscuits, cakes, cookies
Sourcing
Boar's Head meats, St. Armand's bread
Lunch
From 11 AM until close
Price
$10 to $20 per person
